question.text: SEBI can impose penalties for violations under the SEBI Act including:

answer.text: Monetary penalties through adjudication, issuing directions/orders, warning or censure, and suspension or cancellation of intermediary registration
Only requesting the violator to apologize

explanation.text: The Logic: The NISM XV workbook (pages 261 and 268) supports SEBI's powers to impose monetary penalties, undertake adjudication, issue directions/orders, warn or censure intermediaries, and suspend or cancel intermediary registration. The Trap: SEBI's enforcement toolkit is broad, but the workbook pages checked do not specifically support cease-and-desist wording, disgorgement of profits, or criminal-proceeding claims — so the answer keeps to the source-backed actions. Note: Reference pages 261 and 268 of NISM Series XV Research Analyst Workbook (February 2026).
